content.comment_body: Hello, good afternoon. I'm using [product_name] version [version_no], and I noticed that this version seems to lack the 'NOT' function compared to previous versions. Is this correct? Thanks.
Actually, there's another way to apply the 'NOT' function: right-click and select 'invert connector'. This approach helps conserve a block out of the maximum allowed.
However, this method doesn't work in every scenario. For example, you can't invert the input of a digital output or a flag directly; you'll need to use the explicit 'NOT' block in those cases.

analysis.insight_summary: One user was concerned that the 'NOT' function was no longer available in [product_name] [version_no], possibly due to interface or workflow changes. Other participants clarified that the function is still available, though it's accessed differently through connection inversion. Some users noted that this alternative method has limitations and does not fully replace the dedicated 'NOT' block in all situations.
